io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: OAuth; a Leadbase account and workspace access are required.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.interface: Interactive sheets require host MCP Apps support; other clients receive structured results and a Leadbase link.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.overview:
Find your next B2B customers. Know why they fit.

Describe the companies you want to reach. Leadbase researches matching businesses and relevant decision-makers, then saves the results with sources in an editable sheet. Start with 200 free credits in a new workspace and test your own target market.

Qualify companies by the criteria that matter to your offer: services, region and publicly evidenced business signals. Research DACH SMEs and German craft businesses alongside other target markets.

Turn existing accounts into a more useful prospect list. Enrich selected rows or entire columns, research relevant professional contacts and check available contact details. Review the evidence behind returned information before choosing your next step.

Keep control of the result. Follow progress, edit your sheet, filter the list and export the data. Continue the same research instead of rebuilding the list each time.

Use Leadbase with ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other compatible MCP clients. Connect your workspace and ask for a small list in your own target market. Research uses workspace credits.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Every new Leadbase workspace starts with 200 free credits. Research uses workspace credits and plan limits. See https://www.leadbase.io/pricing
